name: agorch
description: Rules for spawning subagents and workflow stages: model and effort per stage, when a command runs directly and when it goes to a reader, several builders in one tree, staged verification, batching tasks into few builders, the writing-briefs skill for the text of a brief, and the writing-text skill for any other text a person will read. Ships five agent types: reader, builder-m, builder-l, reviewer, reviewer-arch.
